children: Salvatore Ferragamo's underlying performance looks decent, analysts at Bernstein write. The Italian luxury-fashion company booked a 3.5% decline in sales over the third quarter, pointing to a gloomy market backdrop, notably in China. Still, there were positive signs in the group's direct-to-consumer retail sales, which were flat on year. That suggests "good fundamentals, despite weak traffic," Bernstein says.
